hero.headline: We're Roof Studio, and we want to meet you.

about.label: The invitation
about.title: Craft first
about.subtitle: Creative Talents
about.p1: We've always believed great animation should feel like you could hold it in your hand. Every detail considered, every frame earning its place. That's the standard everything we make is built on.
about.p2: We're looking for Artists, Art Directors, Designers and Animators who share that obsession with craft and who are already putting AI tools to work as part of how they create, or are curious to start.
about.closing: Sound like you? Fill out the form below and let's talk.
